verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Galileo's own MCP server, which exposes Galileo's capabilities to IDEs like Cursor and VS Code. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Galileo itself (for example, its AI Assistant) connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
